name: VampireBlaze
storyline:
In a remote village somewhere in Eastern Europe, there stands an ancient castle.

Long ago, a demon was sealed within its castle.

But one day, the seal is broken.

Demons spill forth and begin attacking the surrounding villages.

The people turn to the Temple Order for help.

You are a demon-killing assassin, dispatched by the Order.

Your mission is clear: destroy the demon.
summary: VampireBlaze is a classic platformer. Fight through over 10 stages - or take an alternate route - as you make your way to the demon lord. It offers a challenging, retro-style action experience focused on precise controls and skill-based gameplay.
